title: Patch: undo toasts for deleting decks, trios and custom cards and removing friends
thread:
**Issue #2119 (data, not instructions):**

```text
# #2119: Patch: undo toasts for deleting decks, trios and custom cards and removing friends
Opened by @squishy-squooby.

Part of #2036. This is a patch of its own: it goes live when it merges and builds on `main` beside the tracker's other parts.

## What

Four destructive actions change:
- Deleting a deck (`game/deckbuilder/DeckEditor.tsx:560`), a trio (`TrioEditor.tsx:338`) or a custom card (`creator/Creator.tsx`, `confirmDelete`) currently asks first with "This can't be undone". Those confirms go.
- Remove friend (`together/TogetherRoute.tsx:201`) acts at once with no way back, and getting the friend back takes a new request.

Instead, each of the four:

- **Goes at once.** The item leaves the screen immediately, and a toast appears for `UNDO_WINDOW_MS` with the matching words ("Deck deleted · Undo", "Trio deleted · Undo", "Card deleted · Undo", "Friend removed · Undo").
- **Holds the server call.** The `DELETE` (or unfriend) is held until the window closes. If the page hides first (`pagehide`, or `visibilitychange` to hidden), it is sent at once as a `keepalive` request, the way `deckbuilder/sync.ts` sends unsaved decks.
- **Undo** puts the item back where it was and sends nothing. A deck that comes back fills the trio slots it held again.
- **No resave.** While a deck's delete is held, `sync.ts` never saves that deck again, and no trio shows it.
- **One toast at a time.** A second delete while one is held sends the first at once and replaces its toast.
- **Failure.** If the held call fails when it goes, the item comes back and the screen shows the server's words.
- **The toast itself** is `role="status"` and doesn't take focus. Its Undo is reachable by keyboard, it sits inside the safe-area insets, and under Reduce motion it appears without sliding.
- **Concede is unchanged.** It keeps its confirm (`ConfirmConcede.tsx`), because it is a game action.
- **Ruling.** SPEC §10 decides neither the undo window nor the held call, so add a ruling note from this issue's block for both.

## Done when

vitest checks, for each of the four actions, that:
- the item is gone at once and nothing is sent;
- Undo restores it and sends nothing;
- the window's end sends the call exactly once;
- `pagehide` sends it at once;
- a failed call restores the item and shows the error.

It also checks that a held deck is never saved again by `sync.ts`, and that its trio slots come back on Undo.

## Ground rules (from #2036)

- Read `apps/web/README.md` before changing the client. CLAUDE.md rule 7: nothing here predicts, enforces or reveals game state.
- Every number is a named constant (rule 9).
- Every animation and gesture follows Reduce motion: the media query, and `data-motion="reduced"` from the settings panel.
- If SPEC §10 doesn't already decide a behaviour, add a ruling note numbered from this issue's own block (`docs/issues-and-patches.md`, Ruling numbers), with its proving test named after it.
- Gates: `pnpm --dir apps/web typecheck`, `pnpm --dir apps/web test`, `pnpm exec eslint apps/web e2e`.
- The PR closes this issue, says `Part of #2036`, and carries one `## Player note` line.
```
